posts.text: “maybe in life you can’t have everything, but here’s the secret: You can have a hell of a lot.”

I think these words resonate right now because (warning: FEELINGS) I recently made big decisions which resulted in big moves and I’m still not totally on the other side but I’m mostly there, with the people I want to be there with, and… yeah. Nothing is ever perfect all at once. But things can be pretty damn good.
